transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been having trouble with eating at night. After everyone goes to bed, I’ll tell myself I’m just having some leftovers, but then it turns into a lot more—like half a tray of catered pasta, dessert from a client dinner, snacks from the pantry… all in one sitting. It’s embarrassing, but that’s why I’m here.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating once you start during these late-night episodes?

Yes… I think so. Once I start, especially if it’s been a tense night with my husband, it’s like the part of me that’s supposed to decide “enough” just… shuts off. I’ll be thinking, “Patricia, stop, this is enough,” but I keep reaching for more anyway.
How often do these late-night eating episodes happen?
For the past few months… maybe three months, it’s been almost every week. Usually one night, but some weeks it’s happened twice. It tends to be after an argument or if I’ve had a late work event.
Do you feel guilty or ashamed after these late-night eating episodes?

Yes. I feel… really embarrassed afterward. Disgusted with myself, honestly. Like I’ve ruined the disciplined person I try so hard to be. I’ll sit there thinking I should’ve just gone for a run or done yoga instead.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating during these episodes?
No… not really. Once I start, especially after things are tense with my husband, it’s like I’m not making decisions anymore. I’ll be telling myself to stop, but I just keep reaching for more.
Do you feel like you're eating really quickly during these late-night episodes?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t really notice it at the time, but I’ll be standing at the kitchen island, or half-looking at work emails, and then suddenly the containers are just… empty. I barely even taste what I’m eating.
Do you ever try to make up for what you've eaten during these late-night episodes by doing something to counteract it, like vomiting or using laxatives?
Um… I don’t think so. Not vomiting or laxatives, no. I mostly just feel bad about it afterward.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight since these late-night eating episodes started?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been weighing myself much… my clothes maybe feel a little different, but I don’t know if it’s significant.
Do these episodes of eating a lot of food in one sitting ever happen during the day, rather than just at night?

Mostly it’s at night, after everyone’s gone to bed. That’s when I’ll tell myself I’m just having a little leftovers, and then it turns into… a lot. Like pasta from work stuff, dessert, snacks. All in one sitting. During the day, not really in the same way.
Do you ever have episodes during the day where you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?
Not really during the day, no. It’s more after everyone goes to bed… I’ll think I’m just having leftovers, and then it ends up being a lot in one sitting, like the catered pasta, dessert, snacks.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without feeling like you've lost control over your eating?

Not usually, no. Once I start, especially if it’s been a tense night with my husband, it’s like… the part of me that decides is just gone. I’ll be thinking, “Patricia, stop, that’s enough,” and I still keep reaching for more.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control over your eating during the day, even if it's not as frequent as at night?

During the day… not really. The losing-control feeling is more at night, especially after things are tense with my husband. Once I start, it’s like I’m telling myself to stop, but I just keep reaching for more.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time and then not feel guilty or ashamed about it afterward?

No… I usually do feel bad afterward. Embarrassed, mostly. Disgusted with myself, like I’ve ruined this disciplined version of myself I try to keep up. I end up thinking I should’ve gone for a run or done yoga instead.
Do you usually stop eating during these episodes when you feel comfortably full or do you keep eating beyond that point?
I usually keep going past full. By the end I’m… really uncomfortable, like my waistband hurts, and I have to sit upright on the couch for a while because lying down makes me feel sick.
